name: GSoC Alumni Summit 2025
description: Join us in the 2025 of our GSoC Alumni Summit! This will be our 9th year participating in GSoC, and we'll take the opportunity to bring past contributors and students to share their experiences in this virtual event - with an intro by our own founder and project leader, Gabriel Engel.

name: Rocket.Chat Demo Day 2025
description:
Every single year, Rocket.Chat Demo Day showcases open source innovations and major contributions to our platform from our growing open source contributors community. Many of these community members join us from programs such as Google Summer of Code where we’re a proud ninth year participating organization.

Join us in taking a peek at the future of Rocket.Chat, be prepared to be wow’d by the amazing creativity and innovative touches that these “demos” bring. The day will start with a short introduction by Rocket.Chat’s project leader and founder, Gabriel Engel.
